cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't rearrange your life for me. I'll pencil you in for Friday, in case I need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Alex gets the firm booking, then. I'll put you down for the evening. You can keep your phone on while you paint?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. At least I can count on your battery. I'll keep Friday evening clear in my diary for you; it's only sensible planning.
